tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Digital Commerce & Customer Experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and digital commerce solutions. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes, and agile customer experience delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Mitarbeiter Digital Commerce & Customer Experience (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Mitarbeiter Digital Commerce & Customer Experience role at Reico & Partner Vertriebs GmbH. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on expertise engineering enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute my technical depth in SAP Commerce Cloud to your digital commerce landscape.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for major enterprise clients, ensuring high platform performance and robust customer experience.

bullets.label: API & Integration Engineering
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, building reliable data pipelines and resolving integration bottlenecks between PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business requirements and technical execution by analyzing processes, authoring user stories and functional specifications, and collaborating closely with international stakeholders.

bullets.label: Cloud & DevOps Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), managed Docker and Kubernetes environments, and performed database query refactoring to optimize application response latency.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your digital commerce initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise at Reico & Partner Vertriebs GmbH to help drive robust digital commerce platforms and exceptional customer experiences. Your commitment to scalable e-commerce infrastructure aligns perfectly with my background in backend development, API integration, and techno-functional delivery across global enterprise projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java expertise to build high-performing digital commerce platforms and seamless customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience building scalable enterprise platforms and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Digital Commerce role at Reico. My CV and cover letter are attached. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Mitarbeiter Digital Commerce & Customer Experience – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Mitarbeiter Digital Commerce & Customer Experience position at Reico & Partner Vertriebs GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring, I bring deep technical expertise in integrations, APIs, and techno-functional delivery.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am available starting 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
